title: xdrip+ isn't Responding
symptom: xDrip+ throws 'isn't responding' errors every few minutes, even after clearing settings and updating to the most current nightly. The app works and readings are received, but the warning pops up about every 30 seconds regardless of the app in use.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It suggests that incorrect or non-recommended settings may be the cause, and that every instance of this error has been addressed by adjusting xDrip settings to only what is absolutely required.
fix: Adjust xDrip settings to only what is absolutely required, using recommended settings. For Dexcom, ensure settings match the G5 Recommended Settings wiki. For Libre/MiaoMiao, ask for recommended settings in support channels. Additionally, enabling 'Save Database Daily' and setting 'Glucose Retention' to 90 days may help by shrinking the database.
evidence_quote: So far, every instance of this error I have seen has been addressed by adjusting xDrip settings to only what is absolutely required. There was a Dexcom collector case where changing all the Bluetooth and G5/G6 Debug settings to recommended settings stopped the issue.
